
---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
world <- map_data("world")

attacks_by_country <- attacks |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "n_attacks")

world_attacks <- world |>
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(region))) |>
  left_join(attacks_by_country, by = "Country_lower")

ggplot(world_attacks, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) +
  geom_polygon(aes(fill = n_attacks), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightblue",
    high = "darkblue",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Shark Attacks Around the World",
    subtitle = "Number of recorded shark attacks by country",
    fill = "Attacks",
    caption = "Source: Global Shark Attack File"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
